$comment: One fixture set for both copies of the template validator (t-2026-10-12-33): apps/storefront/src/lib/templates/manifest.ts and apps/backend/src/api/tenants/home/template/validation.ts. Each case is `base` with `set` paths written and `delete` paths removed (or `input` in its place); `errors` is the verdict both must give, `field: message`, in order. Read by src/lib/templates/parity.test.ts here and by template-validation.unit.spec.ts on the backend.

base.title: Probe
base.description: A template for the parity fixtures.

cases.name: the base manifest
not an object
errors: _root: A template is a JSON object.

cases.name: another schema
errors: schema: schema must be "upready.storefront-template/v1".

cases.name: an id that is not kebab-case
errors: id: id must be kebab-case: a-z, 0-9 and single hyphens.

cases.name: an empty title and no description
errors: title: title must be a non-empty string.
description: description must be a non-empty string.

cases.name: a header outside the enum
errors: settings.header: header must be one of: h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6.

cases.name: settings missing
errors: settings._root: Body must be a JSON object.

cases.name: FORBIDDEN header h4 with hero k
errors: settings.header: header "h4" with hero "k" is forbidden: Header Accent and hero Announcement both fill their bar with the accent, nothing between.

cases.name: FORBIDDEN footer f6 on a dark page, after an id error
errors: id: id must be kebab-case: a-z, 0-9 and single hyphens.
settings.footer: footer "f6" with defaultMode "dark" is forbidden: Footer Inverted giant wordmark turns light on a dark page — reads as detached, not a foundation.

cases.name: a palette that is not a preset
errors: theme.palette: theme.palette must be one of: default, electronics, geist, home-goods, medusa, sneakers, supplements, womens-fashion, ferma, interier, katalog, lending, moda, opt, uhod.

cases.name: the default palette
a light-only palette with a light page
a light-only palette with a dark page
errors: settings.defaultMode: theme.palette "ferma" has no dark mode; settings.defaultMode must be "light".

cases.name: a font outside the twelve
errors: theme.fontPair.display: theme.fontPair.display must be one of: Geist, Inter, Manrope, DM Sans, Space Grotesk, Playfair Display, Fraunces, Cormorant Garamond, Nunito, Sora, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono.

cases.name: a font pair that is not an object
errors: theme.fontPair: theme.fontPair must be { display, body }.

cases.name: every layer outside its list
errors: theme.radius: theme.radius must be one of: sharp, soft, round, pill.
theme.buttonStyle: theme.buttonStyle must be one of: filled, outlined.
theme.photoStyle: theme.photoStyle must be one of: square, portrait, landscape, wide.
theme.density: theme.density must be one of: compact, comfortable, spacious.

cases.name: theme missing
errors: theme: theme must be an object.

cases.name: no sections
errors: sections: sections must be a non-empty array.

cases.name: a section that is a string
errors: sections[0]: sections[0] must be { block, props? }.
sections: settings.hero is "h" but no hero section places it.

cases.name: a block outside the registry
errors: sections[0].block: hero/zz is not a registered block.
sections: settings.hero is "h" but no hero section places it.

cases.name: a site block as a home section
errors: sections[3].block: header/h2 is drawn on every page from settings.header; it is not a home section.

cases.name: a hero section out of step with settings
errors: sections[0].block: hero/g needs settings.hero "g", the template says "h".

cases.name: the tiles slot placed twice
errors: sections: tiles appears 2 times; the slot renders once.

cases.name: the listing slot switched on and not placed
errors: sections: settings.listing is "p4" but no listing section places it.

cases.name: tiles off and not placed
a placeholder hero renders with an advisory
props on a block that takes none
errors: sections[1].props: tiles/on takes no props from a template.

cases.name: a text bar with its props
a text bar without props
errors: sections[3].props: text must be an object of language code to string

cases.name: a text bar whose props are a string
errors: sections[3].props: props must be an object { text, href }

cases.name: a text bar whose link leads to another site as a path
errors: sections[3].props: href: // leads to another site; write https://

cases.name: a text bar whose link has a space
errors: sections[3].props: href must be one address, no spaces, at most 2048 characters

cases.name: a text bar with every props error
errors: sections[3].props: text.xx: not a language of i18n/config.ts
sections[3].props: text.ru is 141 characters, at most 140
sections[3].props: text.en must be a string
sections[3].props: href must start with / or https://
sections[3].props: color: not a prop of announcement/text-bar

cases.name: a text bar with text that is a list
errors: sections[3].props: text must be an object of language code to string
